dialogues.speaker: Gorchakova
dialogues.text: This place has a little more... how should I put it, natural vitality? It's not covered by snow, ice, and permafrost, and there's plenty of fruit growing here that looks just like Midsommar Berries. These things are rare in Snezhnaya.

dialogues.speaker: Gorchakova
dialogues.text: But, and this may sound a little strange, I still prefer Snezhnograd in the midst of a snowstorm! That's the only time you can truly feel the warmth of "Kresnik's Torch"!

dialogues.speaker: Gorchakova
dialogues.text: Of course, I'm probably biased — it's only natural to have a preference for your hometown.
